49/50 solves. Empty = 0.000 is my best valid design; every multi-column build I evaluated was net-negative (revenue $0 from no stream reaching 95% purity, column costs $124-570M/yr). Team best (island 0) is also negative (-0.336). Reverting to lock 0.000.

Key economics learned: revenue = flow(mol/s) x price x 28.8 ($M/yr). Most valuable cuts would be C5 mix (~$618M/yr) or C6 paraffin mix (~$1180M/yr), but columns cost $124M/yr even for 40 stages/reflux 1.5, and 95% purity on these close-boiling cuts (isoC5/nC5 gap 8K; C6 paraffins vs naphthenes gap 3K) needs very high reflux+stages whose cost exceeds product value at this expensive-plant cost level.

Lesson: at this cost level and with this complex 16-component feed, no achievable-purity separation is profitable; the empty design (0) dominates. Final answer: empty.
